probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A method of treating Argininosuccinate Synthetase Deficiency (ASD), __the method__ comprising administering to a subject in need of treatment a composition comprising an mRNA encoding argininosuccinate synthetase (ASS1) __encapsulated within a liposome__ at an effective dose and an administration interval such that at least one symptom or feature of __the__ ASD is reduced in intensity, severity, or frequency or __is__ delayed in onset.

2. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is encapsulated within a liposome.

3. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome comprises one or more cationic lipids, one or more non-cationic lipids, one or more cholesterol-based lipids and one or more PEG-modified lipids.

4. (Previously presented) The method of claim 3, wherein the one or more cationic lipids comprise a cationic lipid selected from the group consisting of C12-200, MC3, DLinDMA, DLinkC2DMA, cKK-E12, ICE (Imidazol-based), HGT5000, HGT5001, DODAC, DDAB, DMRIE, DOSPA, DOGS, DODAP, DODMA and DMDMA, DODAC, DLenDMA, DMRIE, CLinDMA, CpLinDMA, DMOBA, DOcarbDAP, DLinDAP, DLincarbDAP, DLinCDAP, KLin-K-DMA, DLin-K-XTC2-DMA, HGT4003, and combination thereof.

5. (Previously presented) The method of claim 4, wherein the one or more cationic lipids comprise cKK-E12.

6. (Previously presented) The method of claim 3, wherein the one or more cholesterol-based lipids are cholesterol and/or PEGylated cholesterol.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3, wherein __each of__ the cationic lipid__s__ constitute__s__ about 30-50% of the liposome by weight.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3, wherein the ratio of __the one or more__ cationic lipid__s__:__the one or more__ non-cationic lipid__s__:__the one or more__ cholesterol__-based lipids__:__the one or more__ PEGylated lipid__s__ is approximately 40:30:20:10 by molar ratio.

9. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome comprises a combination selected from: cKK-E12, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; C12-200, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; HGT4003, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; or ICE, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K.

10. (Previously presented) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome has a size less than about 100 nm.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein __the__ effective dose ranges from about 0.1 - 5.0 mg/kg body weight.

12. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the composition is administered intravenously.

13. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the composition is administered once a week.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in __a statistically significant__ increased serum ASS1 protein level __as compared to baseline__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced citrulline level in the subject as compared to the baseline citrulline level before the treatment __wherein the mRNA is encapsulated within a liposome__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced ammonia level in the subject as compared to the baseline ammonia level before the treatment __wherein the mRNA is encapsulated within a liposome__.

17. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is codon optimized.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 17, wherein the codon-optimized mRNA comprises SEQ ID NO:3.

19. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA comprises one or more modified nucleotides.

20. (Cancelled)
